evidence.ACL: There is severe mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, with evidence of chronic partial tear.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: There is a large, complex tear involving the anterior horn and body, extending to the posterior horn, with moderate extrusion.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: Cartilage appears intact.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: Moderate to severe cartilage loss is present, most prominent at the posterior aspect. Small osteophytes.
evidence.PF OA: There is mild cartilage thinning and fissuring at the patella diffusely. Moderate cartilage thinning and fissuring is present at the trochlea diffusely
evidence.Contusion: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
evidence.Fracture: No acute fracture or bone bruise.
